source_claim: Lusterise's official Side Episode page states that Azarin was active in Exs-Tia A and presents side stories for her. The official Exs-Tia 10th anniversary page identifies Exs-Tia A as an installment of the Exs-Tia series. These first-party pages support the exact current member Azarin as belonging to the Exs-Tia Copyright work.
notes: The official Lusterise Side Episode page (https://lusterise.nexton-net.jp/product/exs-tia_a_dl/) describes Azarin as active in Exs-Tia A and identifies her as Exs-Tia Magica in the Side.8 product synopsis. The official 10th-anniversary series page (https://lusterise.nexton-net.jp/product/exs-tia_10th/) lists Exs-Tia A among the series installments. The 10th-anniversary page and official Side Episode page are first-party work identity/series evidence; the current canonical Copyright key is kouyoku_senki_exs-tia. The other five campaign members are omitted because the checked pages did not explicitly establish their exact identities and HOME mapping.
